title: In an irreducible T0 space of dimension at most one, points off a nonempty open are closed
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space which is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components] and Kolmogorov (for any two distinct points of $X$ there is an open subset of $X$ containing exactly one of them), and whose Krull dimension satisfies $\dim X\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be a nonempty open subset and $x\in X\setminus U$. Then $\{x\}$ is closed in $X$.
